ayahs.tr: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
ayahs.tl: Izaa zul zilatil ardu zil zaalaha

ayahs.tr: And the earth discharges its burdens
And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
That Day, it will report its news
Because your Lord has commanded it.

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
ayahs.tr: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
ayahs.tl: Yawma iziy yas durun naasu ash tatal liyuraw a'maalahum

ayahs.ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.tr: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
ayahs.tl: Famaiy ya'mal mithqala zarratin khai raiy-yarah

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.tr: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
